description: Department of Local Government -Eastern Province - Announce that the recalling meeting to select a new Vice Chairman, for the Vacated Vice Chairman's Position of Koralaipattu West P.S. will be Convened on 19.02.202
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting to select a new Vice Chairman for a local authority (Koralaipattu West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including filling a vacated elected position, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
